prompt_text: Write a poem about Counter Strike Global Offensive which jokes about how buggy the game can be. (Hit registration -> hitreg, terrible steam market economy and etc) Also make sure that every line Rhymes!
response_text:
In CS:GO we queue up, hoping for a clean‑cut play,  
But hitreg’s a myth—your bullet’s a ghost, still you claim the win’s a “lucky” play,  
The server spikes like a bad Wi‑Fi, lagging you into a pixelated ballet‑play,  
Your AK‑47 sprays, yet the enemy’s armor stays untouched—what a “hit‑or‑miss” play,  

The Steam market’s a circus, prices swing like a roller‑coaster sway‑play,  
You buy a skin for a fortune, only to watch it drop faster than a stray‑play,  
Bots wander like tourists, forgetting the map, turning every round into a stray‑play,  
Even the grenades seem shy, refusing to explode—just a timid, fizz‑only play,  

Your teammates “spray‑and‑pray,” but the crosshair’s a liar, a mischievous display‑play,  
The scoreboard flips, “MVP” crowned on a player who never fired a single ray‑play,  
Yet we keep pressing “Ready,” because the bugs are part of the charm we’ll forever replay—  
So raise a toast to CS:GO, the glorious, glitch‑filled, forever‑laughing, endless play.
